Part 1: The Emergence of Foundation Models and Generative AI
In this section, Dr. Dario Gil, Senior Vice President and Director of Research at IBM, discusses the rapid pace of AI technology and its implications for businesses. He emphasizes the importance of capturing the moment and harnessing foundation models and generative AI with proper governance. Dr. Gil advises companies to be AI value creators rather than just users, bringing their own data and models to platforms like WatsonX. He stresses the need for transparency, control, and adaptability in AI systems, as well as the importance of building AI into the core of businesses to maximize its potential.

Part 2: WatsonX: An Integrated Data and AI Platform
Dr. Gil introduces WatsonX, IBM's new integrated data and AI platform consisting of three primary parts: watsonx.data, watsonx.ai, and watsonx.governance. He explains how these components work together seamlessly throughout the entire lifecycle of foundation models, from data preparation and training to validation, tuning, and deployment. The platform is built on Red Hat OpenShift, providing seamless integration and the ability to access and deploy AI workloads in any IT environment. Dr. Gil emphasizes the importance of proper governance and the use of a data and model factory to continuously update models without disrupting underlying applications.

Part 3: The Power of Open Source AI and Partnership with Hugging Face
In this section, Dr. Gil invites Clem Delangue, co-founder and CEO of Hugging Face, to discuss the power and creativity of the open source AI community. Delangue shares statistics on the growth of the Hugging Face platform, with over 15,000 companies using it and more than 250,000 open models shared. He emphasizes the importance of companies building their own specialized and customized models to differentiate themselves and maintain control. The partnership between IBM and Hugging Face aims to bring the best of both worlds - the cutting-edge technology and community of Hugging Face and the security and support of IBM - to help businesses create their own internal AI solutions.

Part 4: Embracing the Age of Value Creation with AI
Dr. Gil encourages businesses to embrace the age of value creation with AI, highlighting examples of current AI value creators such as SAP, Red Hat, BBVA, Moderna, NASA, and Wix. He recaps the significant advancements and announcements made by IBM in the past year, including the launch of WatsonX, the development of a family of foundation models, and collaborations with Hugging Face and other initiatives. Dr. Gil offers tips for businesses to consider when harnessing foundation models, such as acting with urgency, being a value creator, betting on community, running efficiently everywhere, and being responsible with continuous governance. He concludes by inviting businesses to join IBM on this journey and build amazing things with foundation models and generative AI.
